Public Health & Applied Informatics

## Mars Cruz, MPH, CHES

Public Health Educator · Program Implementation & Evaluation · Community Partnerships

📍 Denver, CO (Remote) ✉️ nalcs.mika@gmail.com

Public health program manager and community organizer with over eight years of experience in public health advocacy, nonprofit management, and workforce development. I pair compliance education (Title VII, Title IX, ADA) with modern data analytics (SQL, Tableau) and practical AI tools to make institutional systems transparent, accessible, and high-impact.

#### Title VII Compliance Analytics & Reporting

Data analytics initiative at the University of Colorado (22,000+ population) extracting quantitative employee records via SQL to evaluate institutional training compliance, identify outreach gaps, and deliver interactive Tableau dashboards for university executive leadership.

Local AI / LLM Tooling Work Sample

#### Resume Tailor (Local AI Rewriter)

A Windows desktop application designed for privacy-conscious job seekers. Automatically compares resumes against target job postings and prompts a local Ollama LLM instance for surgical rewrite suggestions—ensuring zero sensitive career data is transmitted to cloud APIs.

Key Problem & Architecture:

Offline inference • Contextual prompt engineering • Zero external data leakage

Electron JavaScript Ollama Local LLMs

[View Source Code →](https://github.com/TriBrigadeMars/resume-tailor)

Device Policy & Security Work Sample

#### Android Kiosk Lock Task App

Dedicated Android application utilizing Android enterprise lock task mode to deploy secure, dedicated-use kiosk interfaces. Ideal for community health intake kiosks, clinical screening tablets, and public survey stations.

Application:

Sandboxed field devices • Hardware lock down • Tamper prevention

Android SDK Kotlin / Java LockTask API

[View Repository →](https://github.com/TriBrigadeMars/Android-Kiosk-Lock-Task-App)

### Work Experience

#### Prevention, Education, and Outreach (PEO) Coordinator

September 2024 — Present

University of Colorado · Full-Time (40 hr/week) · Denver, CO

- Design and deliver virtual training and seminars on Title VII, Title IX, and ADA compliance for faculty, students, and employees for an R1 research institution of over 22,000 community members.
- Coordinate statewide conferences to share best practices and evidence-based strategies on Title IX compliance.
- Serve as a technical resource for campus leadership and medical providers, translating complex statutory policy into accessible educational curricula.
- Utilize Tableau and SQL queries to develop Title VII compliance reports from quantitative employee data.
- Conduct employee onboarding and compliance trainings for cohorts of 150+ attendees.

#### Political Outreach Consultant

July 2024 — September 2024

Valley Forward · Part-Time (24 hr/week)

- Informed and engaged community members on local politics; conducted candidate perception surveys.
- Organized canvassing routes for maximum outreach effectiveness leveraging PDI voter data analytics.
- Collaborated with campaign leadership to implement targeted field strategies, driving voter awareness and engagement.

#### Senior Program Coordinator

October 2023 — May 2024

Youth Leadership Institute · Full-Time (40 hr/week)

- Co-facilitated three youth participatory action research electives, engaging 60–70 students per class in critical thinking and leadership development.
- Acted as Project Director for the California Department of Public Health funded program "Mobilizing Youth to Nix Tobacco" (MYNT), managing end-to-end grant evaluation and reporting.
- Developed position papers, talking points, presentations, and consultation responses for statewide tobacco prevention engagement.
- Supported the **$750,000 Sierra San Joaquin Jobs (S2J2) initiative** through coalition building with regional stakeholders.
- Engaged with development, communications, and executive teams on advancing public health policy goals in Fresno County and the Central Valley.
- Managed Senior Program Coordinators to deploy tobacco education initiatives across Fresno and Madera Counties.

#### Community Health Worker

March 2023 — October 2023

Centro La Familia Advocacy Services · Full-Time (36.5 hr/week)

- Supported an active client roster of 15–25 individuals, navigating public benefits, substance use prevention, and housing programs for vulnerable populations.
- Developed monthly reporting pipelines including case summaries and individualized care plans, tracking progress metrics to advocate for local resource allocation.

#### Health Education Specialist

January 2022 — February 2023

Merced County Department of Public Health · Full-Time (40 hr/week)

- Organized and coordinated public health education initiatives for the Local Oral Health Program (LOHP), sustaining coalitions between county health leadership and advisory committees.
- Recruited 10–15 key community stakeholders per presentation cycle to drive program engagement.
- Built custom Microsoft Excel visualizations and data tables using advanced formulas (VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH) to audit and track open-source Medicaid funding utilization in Merced County.

#### Communicable Disease Investigator

October 2020 — December 2021

Fresno County Department of Public Health · Full-Time (40 hr/week)

- Conducted rapid epidemiological screening interviews to trace personal infection sources, managing a liaison caseload of 25–60 school districts.
- Delivered clinical isolation and quarantine guidance for school-based faculty, administrators, and health professionals during emergency COVID-19 pandemic response.

#### Program Coordinator

August 2017 — October 2020

Fresno Barrios Unidos · Full-Time (40 hr/week)

- Coordinated youth development and gang violence prevention programs (Men with Heart & Joven Noble), enrolling over 20 youth per cohort.
- Served as community liaison with City of Fresno councilmembers and municipal staff to advocate for **$500k+ in capital funding** for public wireless networks and bus rapid transit.
- Administered Apricot CRM system to track funding streams, foundation donors, and longitudinal service delivery.
